**A canvas of everything your clips saved.**

Ask your agent for *"a canvas of my assets"*, or run `python3 canvas.py ~/Downloads/artspo` from the skill folder. It writes `canvas.html` in your library: every saved illustration, image, video and animation file on one masonry page.

- Filter by collection and by kind (art, imagery, video, motion).
- Shuffle the order, and size the tiles.
- Light and dark.
- Click any tile for a larger view, how the page used it, and links to the site, its clip.md and the file.

The canvas reads the files in place, so nothing is copied or uploaded. Curated-out files don't show. It's a private view: books never include it.

### Updating

`git pull`, click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`, and run `sh install.sh` so your agent gets `canvas.py`.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.5.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.5.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
